name: compact-session-footer
description: inline composer controls stay on one row and compress status facts in priority order, in both the expanded card and the folded one-line shape

mutation.declaration: Seven manual probes against fresh production CSS: (1) statusrow .context { order: 2 }; (2) 479/559 max-width and 560 min-width query boundaries shifted +20px; (3) composer .leading flex changed to 0 1 auto and promptcard .actions margin-left changed to 0; (4) composer/session/status min-width:0 changed to max-content and overflow:hidden changed to visible; (5) Button outline plus model/effort/session-actions inset focus shadows removed; (6) model trigger width:100% plus model wrapper flex:1 1 72px; (7) statusrow .identity > span:not([data-effort-control]):not(.context) reverted to :not([data-effort-control]) (dropping :not(.context))
mutation.expect: Each probe exits 1 with, respectively: context-to-model order failure; 480/560 visibility failures; Send trailing-edge failure; scroll-width/containment failures; all five focus-ring failures; model shrink-to-fit failure; context wrapper shrink and ring clip failure at 320px
mutation.note: 2026-11-25: probe (1) failed across all 12 fixtures with context-to-model order failure; probe (7) failed at 320px with context wrapper shrinking to 11.0x14.0px and clipping the 14.0x14.0px ring. Probes (2)-(6) reflect the 2026-08-10 baseline (with 400px bar-swap removed).
